synopsis.text: Priority communication alarm goes off at Avengers tower. Nick Fury inform the Avengers that a giant ship has just popped up, out of nowhere on Earth Orbit. Avengers are summoned to the Avengers tower. Wanting to analyse the space-ship and figure out where it came from and what is it doing on the Earth orbit, Avengers go to investigate. Seeing an open airlock, Avengers enter the ship, immediately dividing into smaller group so they can investigate the ship faster. Beast meets Charlie 27 and Nikki, who think he is a monkey, a short fight ensures before the rest of Guardians of the Galaxy arrive. Luckly Starhawk knows who Beast it, and Avengers arrived on the same spot as well, both Thor and Captain America are acquainted with Guardians of the Galaxy and hence they no longer fight.

Guardians of the Galaxy and Avengers introduce themselves properly, Thor recaps him meeting Guardians of the Galaxy and confronting Korvac (as it took place in Thor Annual # 6). After the events of Thor Annual #6 Guardians of the Galaxy followed Korvac who faded away seconds before being caught. Martinex figured out the Korvac had fled to this era hence Guardians of the Galaxy are here to try and stop Korvac.

Korvac plan was to come to this time period, kill this time period’s Vance Astro so he can create an alternate future where he can rule unopposed because Guardians of the Galaxy won’t ever come to be.

The scene cuts to a fashion show being held by the Wasp, which gets crashed by the Porcupine. Starhawk who happens to be watching the show joins Hank Pym and Wasp and Porcupine is easily defeated. Amid the chaos no-one notice a young man, later revealed to be Korvac, meet Carina Walters, and teleport away.
